dedupe_keys.name: idsem an invoices database of the spanish electricity market

description: IDSEM, an invoices database of the Spanish electricity market is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Javier Sánchez et al. This article describes a new database of electricity bills related to energy consumption in Spanish households. The dataset includes individual invoices containing information about the consumption and billing of each supply point. These documents include additional data about the customer, the contract, and the electricity company. Coverage: national (ES); published in 2022. Formats: JSON, PDF. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
